reviews.shade: VT PDRN Reedle Shot 100 50ml + PDRN Essence 100 10ml Special Set
reviews.text: Really enjoying this set! The Reedle Shot feels gentle on my skin and the PDRN Essence leaves it feeling smooth, hydrated and refreshed. I’ve been using it regularly and I’m happy with the results so far.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢套產品！Reedle Shot 用落喺皮膚上感覺好溫和，而 PDRN 精華令皮膚感覺順滑、補足水分同清爽。我一直有定期用，而家為止嘅效果都令我好滿意。

reviews.shade: VT PDRN Reedle Shot 100 50ml + PDRN Essence 100 10ml Special Set
reviews.text: Great set! Nice runny texture, spreads evenly, absorbs well and leaves an even glow. After I applied the essence on top, the skin looked flawless and felt plump. No feeling of clogging. Recommend for evening routine.
reviews.zh: 好正嘅套裝！質地幾流動，容易推開，吸收得好，亦都令皮膚有均勻嘅光澤。我喺上面搽咗精華之後，皮膚睇落好完美，摸落亦好飽滿。冇堵塞嘅感覺。推薦晚間護膚時用。

reviews.shade: VT PDRN Reedle Shot 100 50ml + PDRN Essence 100 10ml Special Set
reviews.text: There was a slight tingling sensation when I first applied it, but it wasn’t bothersome. After using it consistently for a while, I noticed my pores looked smaller and my skin became smoother, firmer, and more radiant.
reviews.zh: 第一次搽嗰陣有微微嘅刺麻感，但係唔會令人困擾。持續用咗一段時間之後，我發現毛孔睇落細咗，皮膚變得更加順滑、緊緻，亦都更有光澤。

reviews.shade: VT PDRN Reedle Shot 100 50ml + PDRN Essence 100 10ml Special Set
reviews.text: Очень интересный продукт! После применения кожа становится более ровной, гладкой и напитанной. Нравится ощущение обновления кожи и красивое сияние. Использую вечером, результат радует. ✨
reviews.zh: 非常有趣嘅產品！用完之後，皮膚變得更加平滑、順滑，同埋更加滋潤飽足。我鍾意皮膚煥然一新嘅感覺，亦都有好靚嘅光澤。我晚上用，效果令我好開心。✨

reviews.shade: VT PDRN Reedle Shot 100 50ml + PDRN Essence 100 10ml Special Set
reviews.text: Absolutely love this! It's gentle on my skin, has a pleasant subtle scent, and delivers exactly what it promises. It has quickly become a staple in my daily skincare routine. A 5-star product for sure
reviews.zh: 真係超鍾意！對我皮膚好溫和，味道淡淡地都幾好聞，而且效果同宣傳嘅一樣。佢好快就成為咗我日常護膚必備嘅產品。絕對係五星級產品

reviews.shade: VT PDRN Reedle Shot 100 50ml + PDRN Essence 100 10ml Special Set
reviews.text: Love using the VT cica reedle shot 100, so I decided to try the PDRN version. It's a bit sticky at first but it does absorbs quickly and feel moisturizing afterwards.
reviews.zh: 我一直好鍾意用 VT cica reedle shot 100，所以決定試吓 PDRN 版本。一開始有少少黏，不過好快就吸收，之後感覺好保濕。

reviews.shade: VT PDRN Reedle Shot 100 50ml + PDRN Essence 100 10ml Special Set
reviews.text: VT PDRN Toner 250ml — lightweight, hydrating toner that gently preps skin for the rest of your routine. Helps soothe, moisturize, and calm the skin with PDRN. Leaves skin soft and refreshed
reviews.zh: VT PDRN Toner 250ml — 質地輕盈、補水嘅化妝水，可以溫和咁為皮膚打底，為之後嘅護膚步驟做好準備。幫助以 PDRN 舒緩、保濕同令肌膚平靜。令皮膚柔軟又清爽。

reviews.shade: VT PDRN Reedle Shot 100 50ml + PDRN Essence 100 10ml Special Set
reviews.text: Amazing product. I used the Reedle Shot together with the PDRN Essence and my skin feels much smoother, more hydrated, and radiant after just a few uses. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly with no sticky feeling. There is a slight tingling sensation at first, which is expected, but it fades fast and does not cause irritation. My skin looks more even, firmer, and healthier. I will definitely repurchase and highly recommend it to anyone looking to boost hydration and skin renewal.
reviews.zh: 非常好嘅產品。我將 Reedle Shot 同 PDRN 精華一齊用，只係用咗幾次，皮膚已經感覺更加順滑、更加補足水分，亦更有光澤。質地輕盈，吸收好快，冇黏膩感。起初會有少少刺麻感，呢個係預期之內嘅，但係好快就會消退，唔會引起刺激。我嘅皮膚睇落更加均勻、更加緊緻、更加健康。我一定會再買，亦非常推薦畀所有想補充水分同更新皮膚嘅人。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
